answer: A farm that parks keys in the jury pool hence watches its influence decay while paying the nebula fee to keep them eligible. Because the echo decay is applied at each close, the ridge audit publishes the reduced weight and the seat has to be earned again. A juror that skips cases loses 9% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. A 203 account operation therefore ties up 23 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
